summary: In August 2026 the ransomware group The Gentlemen claimed on a leak webpage that it had illegally accessed Hong Kong Baptist University's IT systems and data. Monitoring platforms reported that about 1,900 credentials linked to the university may have been compromised, including about 130 staff accounts, 1,770 other user accounts and 260 third-party employee credentials. The university said it had noted the allegation and was reviewing the security of its systems and personal data but did not confirm a breach; the Privacy Commissioner said it had received no breach notification.
